questions.stem: Find the next term: A, C, F, J, O, ?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Positions: A=1,C=3,F=6,J=10,O=15. Differences: +2,+3,+4,+5. Next difference=+6. O(15)+6=21=U. The positions 1,3,6,10,15,21 are TRIANGULAR NUMBERS (1, 1+2, 1+2+3,...).

questions.stem: Find the next term: Z, X, V, T, R, ?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Pattern: descending every 2 letters. Z(26)-2=X(24)-2=V(22)-2=T(20)-2=R(18)-2=P(16). Next = P.

questions.stem: Find the missing term: B, E, H, K, ?, Q
questions.explanation: B is correct. Pattern: +3 each step. B(2),E(5),H(8),K(11),N(14),Q(17). Missing = N. Verify: K(11)+3=14=N; N(14)+3=17=Q ✓.

questions.stem: Find the wrong term: AZ, BY, CX, DW, EV, FU, GT
questions.explanation: C is correct. Each pair: first letter goes A→G (+1 each), second letter goes Z→T (−1 each). Sum of positions always = 27 (e.g., A+Z=1+26=27, B+Y=2+25=27, G+T=7+20=27). All terms in the series are correct.

questions.stem: Find the next group: AB, CD, EF, GH, ?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Pattern: consecutive pairs of the alphabet. AB,CD,EF,GH,IJ,KL... Each pair consists of two consecutive letters, and each group starts where the previous ended.

questions.stem: Find the missing term: BMX, CNY, DOZ, EP?, FQB
questions.explanation: B is correct. Three patterns: 1st letter: B,C,D,E,F (+1); 2nd letter: M,N,O,P,Q (+1); 3rd letter: X,Y,Z,A,B (wraps from Z→A→B). Missing 4th term: E+P+A = EPA.

questions.stem: Find the next term in the series: ABD, CEH, ?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Starting positions of each group: A(1), C(3), F(6) — triangular numbers (1, 3, 6, 10...). Within each group, gaps increase: Group 1 (A+1=B, B+2=D), Group 2 (C+2=E, E+3=H), Group 3 (F+3=I, I+4=M). Group 3 = FIM.

questions.stem: How many letters separate J and R in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: A is correct. J=10th letter, R=18th letter. Letters BETWEEN them (not counting J and R): 11,12,13,14,15,16,17 = K,L,M,N,O,P,Q = 7 letters. Formula: letters between = (higher position − lower position − 1) = 18−10−1 = 7.

questions.stem: If the alphabet is reversed (Z=1, Y=2...A=26), which letter has the same position value as in normal alphabet?

options.option_text: No letter has the same position in both

questions.explanation: C is correct. Normal position = n; reversed position = 27−n. For same value: n = 27−n → 2n = 27 → n = 13.5. Since 13.5 is not an integer, NO letter has the same position in both alphabetical orders. (Compare: M=13 vs reversed position 14; N=14 vs reversed position 13.)

questions.stem: Find the next term: ac, ce, eg, gi, ?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Pattern: each pair consists of the same two letters starting the next pair. ac(1,3) → ce(3,5) → eg(5,7) → gi(7,9) → ik(9,11). The second letter of each pair becomes the first of the next. Differences within each pair = 2 (skip one letter).
